name: Lyra the Fairy Princess
source:
Welcome to the story of Lyra the Fairy Princess, a magical girl who goes through a dark trial.  Explore the relationship between Lyra and her father, Asa, as he processes her disappearance.

When Lyra mysteriously disappears from her room one night, Asa is forced to reflect on the state of their relationship and consider his flaws.

What happened to Lyra, and will she ever come home?

[from [url=https://lizzy-moon.itch.io/lyra-the-fairy-princess]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到仙女公主莱拉的故事，她是一位经历黑暗考验的魔法女孩。探索莱拉和她父亲阿萨之间的关系，了解他处理她失踪的情况。

一天晚上，莱拉从她的房间神秘消失，阿萨被迫反思他们的关系状况并思考自己的缺点。

莱拉出了什么事，她还能回家吗？

[来自[url=https://lizzy-moon.itch.io/lyra-the-fairy-princess]itch.io[/url]]
